items.name: Rose
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE landscape FLOWER MODEL SHEET, hand-drawn 2D TV animation prop design in the visual style of Rick and Morty, matching the supplied cartoon character model sheets. CRITICAL STYLE: very simple slightly irregular BLACK INK outlines, absolutely FLAT SOLID COLOR FILLS, ZERO gradients, ZERO lighting, ZERO realistic texture, ZERO botanical plate rendering, ZERO 3D render. Simplify aggressively into a few readable chunky shapes. No realistic veins, no delicate filigree, no tiny surface details. White plain background. Thin black frames and plain hand-lettered French labels. Upper row: FOUR large full cut-stem views FACE, PROFIL, DOS, TROIS-QUARTS. Lower row: enlarged head DESSUS and DESSOUS plus isolated simple PETALE and FEUILLE and 5 flat palette swatches. Same exact flower in each view with consistent structure; front side back orthographic at equal scale and baseline, all complete stems visible, no roots or pots. The rear must show green calyx and rear petals, not repeat front. Flower only, no added faces on normal flowers. A reference for future 3D modeling, not existing 3D renders.  Title: Rose. Subject: A SIMPLIFIED RED CARTOON ROSE: cup-shaped head with only SIX chunky rounded overlapping outer petal shapes and ONE simple curled spiral line in center, two tones of flat red maximum. Green five-point calyx, slightly bent green cut stem with THREE large triangular thorns and TWO simple jagged leaves. No dense layers, no realistic shading.
